evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies waitNext timeout handling in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp.
rationale: Fixes timeout distortions and test hangs caused by measuring waitNext intervals with wall clock time rather than a monotonic clock. As noted in the description, 'wall clock adjustments distorted timeout durations and mocktime freezing hung timeouts', and switching to steady_clock brings waitNext in line with waitTipChanged.
